chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Ja'far, from his father.
That 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام instructed that an Umm Walad of his should perform ghusl for him when he died, so she washed him.

key_terms.أَوْصَى: he gave instruction or made a bequest
key_terms.أُمُّ وَلَدٍ: a slave woman who bore a child for her master
key_terms.تُغَسِّلَهُ: to wash him ritually after death

ai.seo_question: Who washed Imam 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام after his death according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that 'Ali ibn al-Husayn عليهما السلام left instructions that an Umm Walad belonging to him should wash his body after his death, and that this was carried out. The report is relevant to discussions of funeral washing and related jurisprudential rulings.
